import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { mountAnalysisWorkspace } from '../templates/dashboard/analysis/mount.js';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n,
	options?: { projectSearchHref?: string }
) {
	const result = await mountAnalysisWorkspace(
		element,
		{ i18n, inheritAppearance: true, ...options },
		onError
	);
	return result;
}

import { computed } from 'vue';
import type { AriaAttributes } from 'vue';

// Vue透传的标准ARIA与本预览专用DOM事件；不放宽未知业务属性或事件。
declare module 'vue' {
	interface ComponentCustomProps {
		'aria-label'?: string;
		'aria-current'?: AriaAttributes['aria-current'];
	}
	interface HTMLAttributes {
		onAsamPreviewTheme?: (event: CustomEvent<'light' | 'dark'>) => void;
	}
}

/** 公共输入允许清空或多种标量，页面模型只接收自己声明的合法值。 */
export function choiceModel<Value extends string | number>(
	read: () => Value,
	write: (value: Value) => void,
	choices: readonly Value[]
) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value: unknown) {
			if (choices.some((choice) => Object.is(choice, value))) write(value as Value);
		}
	});
}
export function booleanModel(read: () => boolean, write: (value: boolean) => void) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value: unknown) {
			if (typeof value === 'boolean') write(value);
		}
	});
}
export function textModel(read: () => string, write: (value: string) => void) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value: unknown) {
			if (typeof value === 'string') write(value);
		}
	});
}
ts
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import type { Ref } from 'vue';

export function useDashboardMetricLayout(page: Readonly<Ref<HTMLElement | null>>) {
	const width = shallowRef(1440);
	const columns = computed(() => (width.value < 700 ? 1 : width.value < 1100 ? 2 : 4));
	let observer: ResizeObserver | undefined;

	onMounted(() => {
		const element = page.value;
		if (!element) return;
		const measure = () => {
			width.value = element.getBoundingClientRect().width;
		};
		measure();
		observer = new ResizeObserver(measure);
		observer.observe(element);
	});
	onBeforeUnmount(() => observer?.disconnect());

	return { width, columns };
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, provide, ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCard,
	AsamButton,
	AsamLink,
	AsamTabs,
	AsamTable,
	AsamTableColumn,
	AsamTag,
	AsamEmpty
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { AsamCardGroup, AsamStatisticCard } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import ChartHost from '../../visualization/ChartHost.vue';
import type { ChartSeries } from '../../visualization/Types.js';
import type { AnalysisHost, AnalysisHotspot, AnalysisMetric, AnalysisPeriod } from './Types.js';
import { useAnalysisData } from './State.js';
import { useAnalysisText } from './I18n.js';
import { choiceModel } from '../../cards/Models.js';
import { useDashboardMetricLayout } from '../MetricLayout.js';
const props = withDefaults(
	defineProps<{ host: AnalysisHost; theme?: 'light' | 'dark'; projectSearchHref?: string }>(),
	{ theme: 'light', projectSearchHref: '' }
);
const { i18n, t } = useAnalysisText();
provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
const { width, columns } = useDashboardMetricLayout(useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('page'));
const selectedDays = ref<AnalysisPeriod>(7);
const days = choiceModel(
	() => selectedDays.value,
	(value) => {
		selectedDays.value = value;
	},
	[7, 30]
);
const periods = computed(() => [
	{ value: 7, label: t('week') },
	{ value: 30, label: t('month') }
]);
const locale = computed(() => ('en' === i18n.locale.value ? 'en' : 'zh-CN'));
const chartLocale = computed(() => (locale.value === 'en' ? 'EN' : 'ZH'));
const state = useAnalysisData(
	() => props.host,
	() => ({ days: days.value, locale: locale.value })
);
const metrics = computed<readonly AnalysisMetric[]>(
	() =>
		state.data.value?.metrics ??
		['amount', 'visits', 'active', 'conversion'].map((id) => ({
			id: id as AnalysisMetric['id'],
			value: null,
			change: null
		}))
);
const trend = computed<ChartSeries[]>(() => [
	{ id: 'current', name: t('current'), kind: 'line', points: state.data.value?.current ?? [] },
	{ id: 'previous', name: t('previous'), kind: 'line', points: state.data.value?.previous ?? [] }
]);
const channels = computed<ChartSeries[]>(() => [
	{ id: 'channels', name: t('channels'), kind: 'pie', points: state.data.value?.channels ?? [] }
]);
const hotspots = computed<AnalysisHotspot[]>(() => [...(state.data.value?.hotspots ?? [])]);
const chartError = computed(() => (state.status.value === 'error' ? t('error') : ''));
const cardBody = { padding: 'var(--asam-space-xl)' };
const number = (value: number) =>
	new Intl.NumberFormat(locale.value, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(value);
function setDays(value: string | number) {
	if (value === 7 || value === 30) days.value = value;
}
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamRadioGroup as WebsiteAsamRadioGroup,
	AsamRadioItem as WebsiteAsamRadioItem,
	AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');
function websitePreviewTheme0(event: CustomEvent<'light' | 'dark'>) {
	setTheme(event.detail);
}
function websiteNativeEvent(value: unknown, type: string) {
	const event = new Event(type);
	Object.defineProperty(event, 'target', { value: { value, checked: value } });
	return event;
}

import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamSelect, AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import AnalysisPage from './AnalysisPage.vue';
import { createAnalysisFixture } from './Fixture.js';
import { useAnalysisText } from './I18n.js';
import '../../visualization/Style.css';
defineProps<{
	externalI18n?: AsamI18n;
	inheritAppearance?: boolean;
	diagnostics?: boolean;
	projectSearchHref?: string;
}>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ locale: [value: 'zh-CN' | 'en'] }>();
const { i18n, t } = useAnalysisText(),
	fixture = createAnalysisFixture(),
	theme = ref<'light' | 'dark'>('light');
const audit = computed(() => ({
	...fixture.audit,
	identity: fixture.controls.identity,
	theme: theme.value
}));
function setLocale(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'zh-CN' || value === 'en') emit('locale', value);
}
function setTheme(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'light' || value === 'dark') theme.value = value;
}
function setMode(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'normal' || value === 'empty' || value === 'partial' || value === 'error')
		fixture.controls.mode = value;
}
function setDelay(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 80 || value === 2000) fixture.controls.delayMs = value;
}
onBeforeUnmount(fixture.dispose);
</script>

import type { AnalysisMetricId, AnalysisSnapshot } from './Types.js';
const record = (value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> => {
	if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value))
		throw new TypeError('Invalid analysis object');
	return value as Record<string, unknown>;
};
function finite(value: unknown): number {
	if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value))
		throw new TypeError('Invalid analysis number');
	return value;
}
function text(value: unknown): string {
	if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim()) throw new TypeError('Invalid analysis label');
	return value;
}
function rows(value: unknown) {
	if (!Array.isArray(value)) throw new TypeError('Invalid analysis rows');
	const ids = new Set<string>();
	return value.map((item: unknown) => {
		const row = record(item),
			id = text(row.id);
		if (ids.has(id)) throw new TypeError('Duplicate analysis ID');
		ids.add(id);
		return { row, id };
	});
}
/** 验证完整只读快照后一次提交，非法值不进入统计卡或图表。 */
export function decodeAnalysis(value: unknown): AnalysisSnapshot {
	const data = record(value);
	if (typeof data.partial !== 'boolean') throw new TypeError('Invalid analysis partial flag');
	const metricIds: readonly AnalysisMetricId[] = ['amount', 'visits', 'active', 'conversion'];
	const metrics = rows(data.metrics).map(({ row, id }) => {
		const metricId = metricIds.find((value) => value === id);
		if (!metricId) throw new TypeError('Invalid analysis metric');
		return {
			id: metricId,
			value: row.value === null ? null : finite(row.value),
			change: row.change === null ? null : finite(row.change)
		};
	});
	if (metrics.length !== metricIds.length) throw new TypeError('Missing analysis metric');
	const points = (value: unknown) =>
		rows(value).map(({ row, id }) => ({
			id,
			label: text(row.label),
			value: row.value === null ? null : finite(row.value)
		}));
	const entries = (value: unknown) =>
		rows(value).map(({ row, id }) => {
			const number = finite(row.value);
			if (number < 0) throw new TypeError('Negative analysis count');
			return { id, label: text(row.label), value: number };
		});
	const hotspots = rows(data.hotspots).map(({ row, id }) => {
		const number = finite(row.value);
		if (number < 0) throw new TypeError('Negative analysis count');
		return { id, label: text(row.label), value: number, change: finite(row.change) };
	});
	return {
		metrics,
		current: points(data.current),
		previous: points(data.previous),
		teams: entries(data.teams),
		channels: entries(data.channels),
		hotspots,
		partial: data.partial
	};
}

import { reactive, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { createRequestClient, TransportFault } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import type { AnalysisFilter, AnalysisHost, AnalysisSnapshot } from './Types.js';

/** 合成只读宿主；数值与确认设计一致，不把演示地址映射成真实接口。 */
export function createAnalysisFixture() {
	const controls = reactive({
		mode: 'normal' as 'normal' | 'empty' | 'partial' | 'error',
		delayMs: 80,
		identity: 1
	});
	const audit = reactive({ requests: 0, accepted: 0, cancelled: 0 });
	const client = createRequestClient({
		transport: async (input, context) => {
			++audit.requests;
			const filter = input.params as unknown as AnalysisFilter;
			const mode = controls.mode,
				identity = controls.identity;
			await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
				const abort = () => {
					clearTimeout(timer);
					++audit.cancelled;
					reject(new TransportFault('cancelled'));
				};
				const timer = setTimeout(() => {
					context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					resolve();
				}, controls.delayMs);
				context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
				if (context.signal.aborted) abort();
			});
			if (context.signal.aborted) throw new TransportFault('cancelled');
			if (mode === 'error') throw new TransportFault('network');
			const en = filter.locale === 'en',
				scale = (filter.days === 30 ? 4 : 1) * identity;
			const choose = (zh: string, enText: string) => (en ? enText : zh);
			const snapshot: AnalysisSnapshot = {
				metrics: [
					{ id: 'amount', value: 126560 * scale, change: 12.6 },
					{ id: 'visits', value: 8846 * scale, change: 8.6 },
					{ id: 'active', value: 6560 * scale, change: 8.2 },
					{ id: 'conversion', value: 78.4, change: 3.1 }
				],
				current: Array.from({ length: filter.days }, (_, i) => ({
					id: String(i),
					label: choose('第' + (i + 1) + '日', 'Day ' + (i + 1)),
					value: [39, 62, 51, 84, 65, 93, 58][i % 7]! * scale
				})),
				previous: Array.from({ length: filter.days }, (_, i) => ({
					id: String(i),
					label: choose('第' + (i + 1) + '日', 'Day ' + (i + 1)),
					value: [30, 42, 44, 59, 48, 65, 50][i % 7]! * scale
				})),
				teams: [
					['研发运营组', 'Engineering operations'],
					['产品体验组', 'Product experience'],
					['平台工程组', 'Platform engineering'],
					['质量保障组', 'Quality assurance'],
					['内容运营组', 'Content operations']
				].map(([zh, enText], i) => ({
					id: String(i),
					label: choose(zh!, enText!),
					value: [1246, 1082, 986, 870, 756][i]! * scale
				})),
				channels: [
					['产品需求', 'Product requests'],
					['日常维护', 'Maintenance'],
					['用户反馈', 'User feedback'],
					['其他事项', 'Other']
				].map(([zh, enText], i) => ({
					id: String(i),
					label: choose(zh!, enText!),
					value: [46, 26, 16, 12][i]!
				})),
				hotspots: [
					['设备资料查询', 'Asset information'],
					['流程处理', 'Workflow processing'],
					['知识访问', 'Knowledge visits'],
					['遗留待办', 'Backlog']
				].map(([zh, enText], i) => ({
					id: String(i),
					label: choose(zh!, enText!),
					value: [2846, 1927, 1456, 128][i]! * scale,
					change: [12.6, 8.2, 6.8, -5.2][i]!
				})),
				partial: mode === 'partial'
			};
			++audit.accepted;
			return {
				mode: 'data',
				data:
					mode === 'empty'
						? {
								metrics: snapshot.metrics.map((m) => ({
									...m,
									value: null,
									change: null
								})),
								current: [],
								previous: [],
								teams: [],
								channels: [],
								hotspots: [],
								partial: false
							}
						: mode === 'partial'
							? {
									...snapshot,
									metrics: snapshot.metrics.map((m) =>
										m.id === 'active' ? { ...m, value: null, change: null } : m
									),
									previous: []
								}
							: snapshot
			};
		}
	});
	const host = shallowRef<AnalysisHost>({ owner: { identity: 1 }, client });
	return {
		host,
		controls,
		audit,
		dispose: () => client.dispose(),
		switchIdentity() {
			++controls.identity;
			host.value = { owner: { identity: controls.identity }, client };
		}
	};
}

import { computed, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { createLatestRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import type { AnalysisFilter, AnalysisHost, AnalysisSnapshot } from './Types.js';
import { decodeAnalysis } from './Data.js';

/** 每个页面拥有一个读取容器；继承正常包的取消/晚回包保护。 */
export function useAnalysisData(host: () => AnalysisHost, filter: () => AnalysisFilter) {
	const data = shallowRef<AnalysisSnapshot>();
	const status = shallowRef<'loading' | 'ready' | 'empty' | 'error'>('loading');
	let revision = 0,
		disposed = false;
	let latest = createLatestRequest<AnalysisSnapshot>(host().client, commit);
	function commit(value: AnalysisSnapshot) {
		data.value = value;
		status.value =
			value.metrics.some((metric) => metric.value !== null) || value.current.length
				? 'ready'
				: 'empty';
	}
	async function refresh() {
		if (disposed) return;
		const version = ++revision;
		data.value = undefined;
		status.value = 'loading';
		try {
			await latest.load(
				{ url: 'local:dashboard-analysis', params: { ...filter() } },
				{ decode: decodeAnalysis }
			);
		} catch {
			if (!disposed && version === revision) status.value = 'error';
		}
	}
	watch(
		() => [host().owner, host().client] as const,
		() => {
			++revision;
			latest.dispose();
			data.value = undefined;
			latest = createLatestRequest<AnalysisSnapshot>(host().client, commit);
			void refresh();
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	watch(
		() => [filter().days, filter().locale] as const,
		() => void refresh(),
		{ immediate: true }
	);
	onScopeDispose(() => {
		disposed = true;
		++revision;
		latest.dispose();
		data.value = undefined;
	});
	return { data: computed(() => data.value), status: computed(() => status.value), refresh };
}

import type { RequestClient } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import type { ChartPoint } from '../../visualization/Types.js';

export type AnalysisPeriod = 7 | 30;
export type AnalysisMetricId = 'amount' | 'visits' | 'active' | 'conversion';
export interface AnalysisFilter {
	readonly days: AnalysisPeriod;
	readonly locale: 'zh-CN' | 'en';
}
export interface AnalysisMetric {
	readonly id: AnalysisMetricId;
	readonly value: number | null;
	readonly change: number | null;
}
export interface AnalysisRow {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly label: string;
	readonly value: number;
}
export interface AnalysisHotspot extends AnalysisRow {
	readonly change: number;
}
export interface AnalysisSnapshot {
	readonly metrics: readonly AnalysisMetric[];
	readonly current: readonly ChartPoint[];
	readonly previous: readonly ChartPoint[];
	readonly teams: readonly AnalysisRow[];
	readonly channels: readonly AnalysisRow[];
	readonly hotspots: readonly AnalysisHotspot[];
	readonly partial: boolean;
}
/** 只读前端宿主：身份或数据权限变化必须替换owner引用；不在模板实现真实业务接口。 */
export interface AnalysisHost {
	readonly owner: object;
	readonly client: RequestClient;
}

import { createApp, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey, createAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import App from './App.vue';
/** 演示边界拥有客户端与语言实例；传入的外部语言实例由调用者释放。 */
export function mountAnalysisWorkspace(
	element: Element,
	host?: {
		i18n?: AsamI18n;
		inheritAppearance?: boolean;
		diagnostics?: boolean;
		projectSearchHref?: string;
	},
	onError?: (error: unknown) => void
) {
	const locale = shallowRef<'zh-CN' | 'en'>('zh-CN');
	const i18n = host?.i18n ?? createAsamI18n(() => ({ locale: locale.value }));
	const app = createApp(App, {
		externalI18n: host?.i18n,
		inheritAppearance: host?.inheritAppearance,
		diagnostics: host?.diagnostics,
		projectSearchHref: host?.projectSearchHref,
		onLocale: (value: 'zh-CN' | 'en') => {
			locale.value = value;
		}
	});
	app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'dashboard-analysis-demo' });
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	app.mount(element);
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		app.unmount();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
	};
}

			: {}),
		...(props.series.some((item) => item.kind !== 'pie') &&

function paint() {

	engineError.value = '';
	engineFailure.value = undefined;
	if (diagnostic.value || empty.value) {
		instance.setOption({ backgroundColor: 'transparent' }, { notMerge: true });
		return;
	}
	const cartesian = props.series.some((s) => s.kind !== 'pie');
	const option: EChartsCoreOption = {
		backgroundColor: 'transparent',
		animation: !(props.reducedMotion ?? motion.value),
		color: ['#167d8d', '#dc9142', '#7a74b8'],
		aria: { enabled: true, decal: { show: true } },
		tooltip: { trigger: 'item', renderMode: 'richText', confine: true },
		legend: {
			show: cartesian,
			data: props.series.map((s) => s.name),
			top: 0,
			selected: { ...selected.value },
			textStyle: { color: props.theme === 'dark' ? '#e5ecf1' : '#334155' }
		},
		...(cartesian
			? {
					grid: { top: 40, left: 55, right: 20, bottom: 65 },
					xAxis: { type: 'category', data: props.series[0]?.points.map((p) => p.label) },
					yAxis: { type: 'value' },
					dataZoom: [{ type: 'slider', bottom: 5 }, { type: 'inside' }]
				}
			: {}),
		...localizedOption(),
		...props.option,
		series: props.series.map((s) => ({
			id: s.id,
			name: s.name,
			type: s.kind,
			...(s.kind === 'pie'
				? {
						radius: ['28%', '64%'],
						center: ['50%', '55%'],
						label: { show: false },
						labelLine: { show: false }
					}
				: { showSymbol: false }),
			...(s.color ? { itemStyle: { color: s.color } } : {}),
			data:
				s.kind === 'pie' && selected.value[s.name] === false
					? []
					: s.points.map((p) => ({ id: p.id, name: p.label, value: p.value }))
		}))
	};
	try {
		instance.setOption(option, { notMerge: true });
		engineError.value = '';
		engineFailure.value = undefined;
	} catch {
		engineError.value = '图表配置无法渲染';
		engineFailure.value = 'renderFailed';
		emit('error', engineError.value);
	}
}
function destroyInstance() {
	++revision;
	instance?.dispose();
	instance = undefined;
}
async function initialize() {
	const generation = ++revision;
	engineError.value = '';
	engineFailure.value = undefined;
	let created: EChartsType | undefined;
	try {
		const { init } = await loadEngine(loadAttempt++);
		await nextTick();
		if (!mounted || disposed || generation !== revision || !container.value) return;
		created = init(container.value, props.theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : undefined, {
			renderer: 'svg',
			locale: props.locale
		});
		instance = created;
		instance.on('click', (event: { seriesId?: string; dataIndex?: number }) => {
			if (event.seriesId && event.dataIndex !== undefined)
				select(event.seriesId, event.dataIndex);
		});
		instance.on('legendselectchanged', (event: unknown) => {
			if (
				!event ||
				typeof event !== 'object' ||
				!('selected' in event) ||
				!event.selected ||
				typeof event.selected !== 'object'
			)
				return;
			const values = Object.fromEntries(
				Object.entries(event.selected).filter(
					(entry): entry is [string, boolean] => typeof entry[1] === 'boolean'
				)
			);
			selected.value = values;
			emit('legend', { ...values });
		});
		instance.on('datazoom', (event: unknown) => emit('zoom', event));
		paint();
		emit('ready');
	} catch {
		created?.dispose();
		if (!mounted || disposed || generation !== revision) return;
		if (instance === created) instance = undefined;
		engineError.value = '图表引擎加载或初始化失败，请重试';
		engineFailure.value = 'engineFailed';
		emit('error', engineError.value);
	}

function retry() {

	() => {

			destroyInstance();
			void initialize();
		}
	}
);

watch(
	() => [
		i18n.locale.value,
		i18n.enabled.value,
		i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.chartDescription', {
			title: props.title,
			count: props.series.length
		})
	],
	() => {
		if (instance && !disposed && i18n.enabled.value && !diagnostic.value && !empty.value) {
			try {
				instance.setOption(localizedOption(), { notMerge: false });

onBeforeUnmount(() => {

	dispose();
});
defineExpose<ChartExpose>({
	resize,
	dispose,
	getInstance: () => instance,
	dispatchAction: (action) => instance?.dispatchAction(action),
	getDataURL: () => instance?.getDataURL({ type: 'svg' })
});
</script>

import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import type { ChartSeries } from './Types.js';
/** Validate before invoking the engine. Null is a gap, zero and signed decimals are values. */
export function validateSeries(
	series: readonly ChartSeries[],
	scope?: AsamI18n
): string | undefined {
	const ids = new Set<string>();
	for (const item of series) {
		if (!item.id || ids.has(item.id))
			return scope?.enabled.value
				? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.seriesId')
				: 'series ID 缺失或重复';
		ids.add(item.id);
		if (!['line', 'bar', 'pie'].includes(item.kind))
			return scope?.enabled.value
				? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.chartKind')
				: '未注册的图表类型';
		const points = new Set<string>();
		for (const point of item.points) {
			if (!point.id || points.has(point.id))
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.pointId')
					: 'point ID 缺失或重复';
			points.add(point.id);
			if (point.value !== null && !Number.isFinite(point.value))
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.finite')
					: '图表值必须为有限数字或 null';
			if (item.kind === 'pie' && point.value !== null && point.value < 0)
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.negativePie')
					: '饼图不支持负数；请使用折线或柱图';
		}
	}
}

]);
export { init };

import type * as ChartEngine from './Engine.js';
/** Vite resolves this marker to its own emitted entry, including the configured base URL.
 * A fresh URL on retry avoids the browser's cached rejected dynamic-import promise.
 * No remote scripts, copied engine code or alternate dependency instance are used.
 */
let loaded: typeof ChartEngine | undefined;
export async function loadEngine(attempt: number): Promise<typeof ChartEngine> {
	if (loaded) return loaded;
	const url = new URL('__ASAM_ENGINE_URL__', import.meta.url);
	if (attempt > 0) url.searchParams.set('asam-retry', String(attempt));
	const engine: typeof ChartEngine = await import(/* @vite-ignore */ url.href);
	loaded = engine;
	return engine;
}
css
.viz-shell {
	--viz-bg: var(--asam-color-surface-muted, #f3f6f7);
	--viz-surface: var(--asam-color-surface, #fff);
	--viz-text: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #20363e);
	--viz-border: var(--asam-color-border, #d8e1e5);
	--viz-control: 32px;
	background: var(--viz-bg);
	color: var(--viz-text);
	min-height: 100%;
	font: 14px/1.5 var(--asam-typography-font-family, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);
}
.viz-shell.dark {
	color-scheme: dark;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='large'] {
	--viz-control: 40px;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='big'] {
	--viz-control: 36px;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='small'] {
	--viz-control: 28px;
}
body {
	margin: 0;
}
.viz-shell * {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.viz-shell nav {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 16px;
	padding: 16px 3vw;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.viz-shell nav strong {
	margin-right: auto;
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}
.viz-shell small {
	font-size: 10px;
	font-weight: 400;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']),
.viz-shell input:not([class*='el-']),
.viz-shell select:not([class*='el-']) {
	font: inherit;
	color: inherit;
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-control, 4px);
	min-height: var(--viz-control);
	line-height: 20px;
	padding: 3px 10px;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']) {
	cursor: pointer;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']):hover,
.viz-shell [aria-current='page']:not(.el-button) {
	border-color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
	color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
}
.viz-shell :focus-visible {
	outline: 3px solid var(--asam-semantic-focus);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
.viz-shell input:not([class*='el-'])[type='checkbox'] {
	min-height: 0;
}
.viz-page {
	max-width: 1600px;
	margin: auto;
	padding: 28px 3vw;
}
.viz-heading {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 16px;
	margin-bottom: 22px;
}
.viz-heading h1 {
	font-size: 32px;
	letter-spacing: -0.035em;
	margin: 4px 0;
}
.viz-heading p {
	margin: 0;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary, #657983);
}
.viz-eyebrow {
	font-size: 11px;
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}
.viz-toolbar {
	display: flex;
	align-items: end;
	gap: 12px;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.viz-toolbar label {
	display: grid;
	gap: 4px;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-shell nav label {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 5px;
}
.viz-analysis-grid {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr;
	gap: 18px;
	margin-top: 24px;
}
.viz-analysis-grid > .viz-chart:first-child {
	grid-column: 1/-1;
}
.viz-monitor-grid {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
	gap: 16px;
	margin-top: 24px;
}
.viz-chart {
	min-width: 0;
	padding: 18px;
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-card, 8px);
}
.viz-chart header {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
}
.viz-chart h2 {
	font-size: 15px;
	margin: 0 0 12px;
}
.viz-chart .asam-form-section {
	border: 0;
	padding: 0;
	display: flex;
	gap: 12px;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-chart .asam-form-section-title {
	font-size: 11px;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary, #657983);
}
.viz-plot {
	width: 100%;
}
.viz-chart summary {
	cursor: pointer;
	font-size: 12px;
	margin-top: 12px;
}
.viz-table {
	max-height: 260px;
	overflow: auto;
}
.viz-table table {
	border-collapse: collapse;
	width: 100%;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-table th,
.viz-table td {
	text-align: left;
	padding: 6px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
}
.viz-status {
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	padding: 6px 12px;
	border-radius: 20px;
}
.viz-shell .asam-card-group {
	margin: 18px 0;
}
@media (max-width: 700px) {
	.viz-analysis-grid,
	.viz-monitor-grid {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
	.viz-heading h1 {
		font-size: 26px;
	}
	.viz-shell nav {
		gap: 9px;
	}
	.viz-shell nav strong {
		width: 100%;
	}
	.viz-toolbar input:not([class*='el-']) {
		max-width: 100%;
	}
	.viz-chart {
		padding: 12px;
	}
	.viz-page {
		padding: 20px 14px;
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
	.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']) {
		transition:
			border-color 0.15s,
			color 0.15s;
	}
	.viz-page {
		animation: viz-enter 0.18s ease-out;
	}
	@keyframes viz-enter {
		from {
			opacity: 0.4;
			transform: translateY(3px);
		}
		to {
			opacity: 1;
			transform: none;
		}
	}
}

import type { EChartsCoreOption, EChartsType } from 'echarts/core';
export type ChartKind = 'line' | 'bar' | 'pie';
export interface ChartPoint {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly label: string;
	readonly value: number | null;
}
export interface ChartSeries {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly name: string;
	readonly kind: ChartKind;
	readonly points: readonly ChartPoint[];
	readonly color?: string;
}
export interface ChartSelection {
	seriesId: string;
	pointId: string;
	index: number;
	value: number | null;
}
export interface ChartProps {
	title: string;
	series: readonly ChartSeries[];
	/** Trusted application option only. Never deserialize executable formatters from remote input. */
	option?: EChartsCoreOption;
	loading?: boolean;
	error?: string;
	theme?: 'light' | 'dark';
	locale?: 'ZH' | 'EN';
	/** Omitted follows the live system preference; explicit false enables animation. */
	reducedMotion?: boolean;
	showTable?: boolean;
	height?: number;
}
export interface ChartExpose {
	resize(): void;
	dispose(): void;
	getInstance(): EChartsType | undefined;
	dispatchAction(action: Parameters<EChartsType['dispatchAction']>[0]): void;
	getDataURL(): string | undefined;
}
export type ConnectionState =
	'idle' | 'connecting' | 'live' | 'reconnecting' | 'paused' | 'stale' | 'error' | 'closed';
export interface StreamPoint {
	readonly stream: string;
	readonly seq: number;
	readonly at: number;
	readonly value: number | null;
}
export interface Subscription {
	close(): void;
}
export interface StreamSink {
	open(): void;
	message(point: StreamPoint): void;
	error(): void;
}
export interface SubscribeSource {
	readonly id: string;
	subscribe(sink: StreamSink): Subscription;
}
export interface PollSource {
	readonly id: string;
	poll(signal: AbortSignal): Promise<readonly StreamPoint[]>;
}
export type MonitorSource = SubscribeSource | PollSource;
export interface MonitorOptions {
	streams: readonly string[];
	capacity?: number;
	intervalMs?: number;
	batchMs?: number;
	reconnects?: number;
	backoffMs?: number;
}
export interface MonitorSnapshot {
	state: ConnectionState;
	source: string;
	attempts: number;
	dropped: number;
	lastAt: number | null;
	points: Readonly<Record<string, readonly StreamPoint[]>>;
}
export interface AnalyticsFilter {
	category: 'all' | 'north' | 'south';
	range: number;
	mode: 'normal' | 'empty' | 'partial' | 'error';
	delayMs?: number;
}
export interface AnalyticsData {
	readonly points: readonly ChartPoint[];
	readonly total: number;
	readonly partial: boolean;
}

import { resolve, relative } from 'node:path';

// Keep the accepted loader's retryable dynamic import. Only resolve its URL to
// Vite's own emitted entry; the engine and chart algorithms remain unchanged.
export function asamVisualizationEngine(
	sourceRoot = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..'),
	{ language = 'ts' } = {}
) {
	if (!['ts', 'js'].includes(language)) throw Error('图表引擎仅支持TS或JS同源入口');
	const engine = resolve(sourceRoot, `templates/visualization/Engine.${language}`);
	const loader = resolve(sourceRoot, `templates/visualization/EngineLoader.${language}`);
	const normalize = (path) => path.replaceAll('\\', '/');
	let config;
	return {
		name: 'asam-visualization-engine-url',
		configResolved(value) {
			config = value;
		},
		transform(code, id) {
			if (normalize(id.split('?')[0]) !== normalize(loader)) return;
			const marker = /['"]__ASAM_ENGINE_URL__['"]/;
			if (!marker.test(code)) this.error('EngineLoader.ts 缺少预期的引擎 URL 标记');
			const path = normalize(relative(config.root, engine));
			const devPath = path.startsWith('../') ? '@fs/' + normalize(engine) : path;
			const url =
				config.command === 'build'
					? `import.meta.ROLLUP_FILE_URL_${this.emitFile({ type: 'chunk', id: engine, name: 'Engine', preserveSignature: 'strict' })}`
					: // This is already a Vite-served URL with its base applied. Prevent
						// Vite's asset new-URL transform from resolving it as another file.
						`/* @vite-ignore */ ${JSON.stringify(config.base + encodeURI(devPath))}`;
			return { code: code.replace(marker, url), map: null };
		}
	};
}

import { computed } from 'vue';
/** 公共输入允许清空或多种标量，页面模型只接收自己声明的合法值。 */
export function choiceModel(read, write, choices) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value) {
			if (choices.some((choice) => Object.is(choice, value))) write(value);
		}
	});
}
export function booleanModel(read, write) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value) {
			if (typeof value === 'boolean') write(value);
		}
	});
}
export function textModel(read, write) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value) {
			if (typeof value === 'string') write(value);
		}
	});
}

import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, shallowRef } from 'vue';
export function useDashboardMetricLayout(page) {
	const width = shallowRef(1440);
	const columns = computed(() => (width.value < 700 ? 1 : width.value < 1100 ? 2 : 4));
	let observer;
	onMounted(() => {
		const element = page.value;
		if (!element) return;
		const measure = () => {
			width.value = element.getBoundingClientRect().width;
		};
		measure();
		observer = new ResizeObserver(measure);
		observer.observe(element);
	});
	onBeforeUnmount(() => observer?.disconnect());
	return { width, columns };
}

const record = (value) => {
	if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value))
		throw new TypeError('Invalid analysis object');
	return value;
};
function finite(value) {
	if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value))
		throw new TypeError('Invalid analysis number');
	return value;
}
function text(value) {
	if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim()) throw new TypeError('Invalid analysis label');
	return value;
}
function rows(value) {
	if (!Array.isArray(value)) throw new TypeError('Invalid analysis rows');
	const ids = new Set();
	return value.map((item) => {
		const row = record(item),
			id = text(row.id);
		if (ids.has(id)) throw new TypeError('Duplicate analysis ID');
		ids.add(id);
		return { row, id };
	});
}
/** 验证完整只读快照后一次提交，非法值不进入统计卡或图表。 */
export function decodeAnalysis(value) {
	const data = record(value);
	if (typeof data.partial !== 'boolean') throw new TypeError('Invalid analysis partial flag');
	const metricIds = ['amount', 'visits', 'active', 'conversion'];
	const metrics = rows(data.metrics).map(({ row, id }) => {
		const metricId = metricIds.find((value) => value === id);
		if (!metricId) throw new TypeError('Invalid analysis metric');
		return {
			id: metricId,
			value: row.value === null ? null : finite(row.value),
			change: row.change === null ? null : finite(row.change)
		};
	});
	if (metrics.length !== metricIds.length) throw new TypeError('Missing analysis metric');
	const points = (value) =>
		rows(value).map(({ row, id }) => ({
			id,
			label: text(row.label),
			value: row.value === null ? null : finite(row.value)
		}));
	const entries = (value) =>
		rows(value).map(({ row, id }) => {
			const number = finite(row.value);
			if (number < 0) throw new TypeError('Negative analysis count');
			return { id, label: text(row.label), value: number };
		});
	const hotspots = rows(data.hotspots).map(({ row, id }) => {
		const number = finite(row.value);
		if (number < 0) throw new TypeError('Negative analysis count');
		return { id, label: text(row.label), value: number, change: finite(row.change) };
	});
	return {
		metrics,
		current: points(data.current),
		previous: points(data.previous),
		teams: entries(data.teams),
		channels: entries(data.channels),
		hotspots,
		partial: data.partial
	};
}

import { computed, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { createLatestRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { decodeAnalysis } from './Data.js';
/** 每个页面拥有一个读取容器；继承正常包的取消/晚回包保护。 */
export function useAnalysisData(host, filter) {
	const data = shallowRef();
	const status = shallowRef('loading');
	let revision = 0,
		disposed = false;
	let latest = createLatestRequest(host().client, commit);
	function commit(value) {
		data.value = value;
		status.value =
			value.metrics.some((metric) => metric.value !== null) || value.current.length
				? 'ready'
				: 'empty';
	}
	async function refresh() {
		if (disposed) return;
		const version = ++revision;
		data.value = undefined;
		status.value = 'loading';
		try {
			await latest.load(
				{ url: 'local:dashboard-analysis', params: { ...filter() } },
				{ decode: decodeAnalysis }
			);
		} catch {
			if (!disposed && version === revision) status.value = 'error';
		}
	}
	watch(
		() => [host().owner, host().client],
		() => {
			++revision;
			latest.dispose();
			data.value = undefined;
			latest = createLatestRequest(host().client, commit);
			void refresh();
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	watch(
		() => [filter().days, filter().locale],
		() => void refresh(),
		{ immediate: true }
	);
	onScopeDispose(() => {
		disposed = true;
		++revision;
		latest.dispose();
		data.value = undefined;
	});
	return { data: computed(() => data.value), status: computed(() => status.value), refresh };
}

import { createApp, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey, createAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import App from './App.vue';
/** 演示边界拥有客户端与语言实例；传入的外部语言实例由调用者释放。 */
export function mountAnalysisWorkspace(element, host, onError) {
	const locale = shallowRef('zh-CN');
	const i18n = host?.i18n ?? createAsamI18n(() => ({ locale: locale.value }));
	const app = createApp(App, {
		externalI18n: host?.i18n,
		inheritAppearance: host?.inheritAppearance,
		diagnostics: host?.diagnostics,
		projectSearchHref: host?.projectSearchHref,
		onLocale: (value) => {
			locale.value = value;
		}
	});
	app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'dashboard-analysis-demo' });
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	app.mount(element);
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		app.unmount();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
	};
}

/** Validate before invoking the engine. Null is a gap, zero and signed decimals are values. */
export function validateSeries(series, scope) {
	const ids = new Set();
	for (const item of series) {
		if (!item.id || ids.has(item.id))
			return scope?.enabled.value
				? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.seriesId')
				: 'series ID 缺失或重复';
		ids.add(item.id);
		if (!['line', 'bar', 'pie'].includes(item.kind))
			return scope?.enabled.value
				? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.chartKind')
				: '未注册的图表类型';
		const points = new Set();
		for (const point of item.points) {
			if (!point.id || points.has(point.id))
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.pointId')
					: 'point ID 缺失或重复';
			points.add(point.id);
			if (point.value !== null && !Number.isFinite(point.value))
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.finite')
					: '图表值必须为有限数字或 null';
			if (item.kind === 'pie' && point.value !== null && point.value < 0)
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.negativePie')
					: '饼图不支持负数；请使用折线或柱图';
		}
	}
}

import { init, use } from 'echarts/core';
import { LineChart, BarChart, PieChart } from 'echarts/charts';
import {
	GridComponent,
	TooltipComponent,
	LegendComponent,
	DataZoomComponent,
	AriaComponent
} from 'echarts/components';
import { SVGRenderer } from 'echarts/renderers';
use([
	LineChart,
	BarChart,
	PieChart,
	GridComponent,
	TooltipComponent,
	LegendComponent,
	DataZoomComponent,
	AriaComponent,
	SVGRenderer
]);
export { init };

/** Vite resolves this marker to its own emitted entry, including the configured base URL.
 * A fresh URL on retry avoids the browser's cached rejected dynamic-import promise.
 * No remote scripts, copied engine code or alternate dependency instance are used.
 */
let loaded;
export async function loadEngine(attempt) {
	if (loaded) return loaded;
	const url = new URL('__ASAM_ENGINE_URL__', import.meta.url);
	if (attempt > 0) url.searchParams.set('asam-retry', String(attempt));
	const engine = await import(/* @vite-ignore */ url.href);
	loaded = engine;
	return engine;
}
css
.viz-shell {
	--viz-bg: var(--asam-color-surface-muted, #f3f6f7);
	--viz-surface: var(--asam-color-surface, #fff);
	--viz-text: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #20363e);
	--viz-border: var(--asam-color-border, #d8e1e5);
	--viz-control: 32px;
	background: var(--viz-bg);
	color: var(--viz-text);
	min-height: 100%;
	font: 14px/1.5 var(--asam-typography-font-family, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);
}
.viz-shell.dark {
	color-scheme: dark;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='large'] {
	--viz-control: 40px;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='big'] {
	--viz-control: 36px;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='small'] {
	--viz-control: 28px;
}
body {
	margin: 0;
}
.viz-shell * {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.viz-shell nav {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 16px;
	padding: 16px 3vw;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.viz-shell nav strong {
	margin-right: auto;
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}
.viz-shell small {
	font-size: 10px;
	font-weight: 400;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']),
.viz-shell input:not([class*='el-']),
.viz-shell select:not([class*='el-']) {
	font: inherit;
	color: inherit;
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-control, 4px);
	min-height: var(--viz-control);
	line-height: 20px;
	padding: 3px 10px;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']) {
	cursor: pointer;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']):hover,
.viz-shell [aria-current='page']:not(.el-button) {
	border-color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
	color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
}
.viz-shell :focus-visible {
	outline: 3px solid var(--asam-semantic-focus);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
.viz-shell input:not([class*='el-'])[type='checkbox'] {
	min-height: 0;
}
.viz-page {
	max-width: 1600px;
	margin: auto;
	padding: 28px 3vw;
}
.viz-heading {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 16px;
	margin-bottom: 22px;
}
.viz-heading h1 {
	font-size: 32px;
	letter-spacing: -0.035em;
	margin: 4px 0;
}
.viz-heading p {
	margin: 0;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary, #657983);
}
.viz-eyebrow {
	font-size: 11px;
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}
.viz-toolbar {
	display: flex;
	align-items: end;
	gap: 12px;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.viz-toolbar label {
	display: grid;
	gap: 4px;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-shell nav label {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 5px;
}
.viz-analysis-grid {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr;
	gap: 18px;
	margin-top: 24px;
}
.viz-analysis-grid > .viz-chart:first-child {
	grid-column: 1/-1;
}
.viz-monitor-grid {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
	gap: 16px;
	margin-top: 24px;
}
.viz-chart {
	min-width: 0;
	padding: 18px;
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-card, 8px);
}
.viz-chart header {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
}
.viz-chart h2 {
	font-size: 15px;
	margin: 0 0 12px;
}
.viz-chart .asam-form-section {
	border: 0;
	padding: 0;
	display: flex;
	gap: 12px;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-chart .asam-form-section-title {
	font-size: 11px;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary, #657983);
}
.viz-plot {
	width: 100%;
}
.viz-chart summary {
	cursor: pointer;
	font-size: 12px;
	margin-top: 12px;
}
.viz-table {
	max-height: 260px;
	overflow: auto;
}
.viz-table table {
	border-collapse: collapse;
	width: 100%;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-table th,
.viz-table td {
	text-align: left;
	padding: 6px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
}
.viz-status {
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	padding: 6px 12px;
	border-radius: 20px;
}
.viz-shell .asam-card-group {
	margin: 18px 0;
}
@media (max-width: 700px) {
	.viz-analysis-grid,
	.viz-monitor-grid {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
	.viz-heading h1 {
		font-size: 26px;
	}
	.viz-shell nav {
		gap: 9px;
	}
	.viz-shell nav strong {
		width: 100%;
	}
	.viz-toolbar input:not([class*='el-']) {
		max-width: 100%;
	}
	.viz-chart {
		padding: 12px;
	}
	.viz-page {
		padding: 20px 14px;
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
	.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']) {
		transition:
			border-color 0.15s,
			color 0.15s;
	}
	.viz-page {
		animation: viz-enter 0.18s ease-out;
	}
	@keyframes viz-enter {
		from {
			opacity: 0.4;
			transform: translateY(3px);
		}
		to {
			opacity: 1;
			transform: none;
		}
	}
}

import { resolve, relative } from 'node:path';

// Keep the accepted loader's retryable dynamic import. Only resolve its URL to
// Vite's own emitted entry; the engine and chart algorithms remain unchanged.
export function asamVisualizationEngine(
	sourceRoot = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..'),
	{ language = 'js' } = {}
) {
	if (!['ts', 'js'].includes(language)) throw Error('图表引擎仅支持TS或JS同源入口');
	const engine = resolve(sourceRoot, `templates/visualization/Engine.${language}`);
	const loader = resolve(sourceRoot, `templates/visualization/EngineLoader.${language}`);
	const normalize = (path) => path.replaceAll('\\', '/');
	let config;
	return {
		name: 'asam-visualization-engine-url',
		configResolved(value) {
			config = value;
		},
		transform(code, id) {
			if (normalize(id.split('?')[0]) !== normalize(loader)) return;
			const marker = /['"]__ASAM_ENGINE_URL__['"]/;
			if (!marker.test(code)) this.error('EngineLoader.ts 缺少预期的引擎 URL 标记');
			const path = normalize(relative(config.root, engine));
			const devPath = path.startsWith('../') ? '@fs/' + normalize(engine) : path;
			const url =
				config.command === 'build'
					? `import.meta.ROLLUP_FILE_URL_${this.emitFile({ type: 'chunk', id: engine, name: 'Engine', preserveSignature: 'strict' })}`
					: // This is already a Vite-served URL with its base applied. Prevent
						// Vite's asset new-URL transform from resolving it as another file.
						`/* @vite-ignore */ ${JSON.stringify(config.base + encodeURI(devPath))}`;
			return { code: code.replace(marker, url), map: null };
		}
	};
}

面向团队运营的独立分析页：四个关键指标、增长趋势与团队排名、来源渠道和热门指标。周期切换会真实重新读取本地合成数据；不连接真实业务服务。

读取与状态

刷新、7日/30日切换与语言变化沿现有请求协议读取。加载、失败、空数据均不展示旧快照；部分响应保留可用值并明确缺失。身份或权限变化须替换owner引用，立即清除旧数据并取消旧请求。页面卸载释放自己的请求容器，宿主客户端仍归调用者。

前端宿主契约

接口说明
AnalysisPage.host只读宿主。提供当前owner引用和正常RequestClient；宿主负责业务地址与响应映射。
AnalysisPage.themelight或dark，默认light；同步传给真实图表引擎。
AnalysisFilterdays选择7或30；locale决定宿主返回的标签语言。
AnalysisSnapshot四指标、两期趋势、团队排名、渠道与热门指标；null表示缺失数值，partial标记不完整快照。
mountAnalysisWorkspace挂载本地合成演示；返回幂等释放函数。外部i18n实例继续归调用者。

复用与来源

真实使用ASAM统计卡、卡片、标签、周期页签及表格，图表复用templates/visualization/ChartHost.vue及其ChartSeries、动态引擎和可访问数据表。原通用分析页与服务不变；不捆绑monitor或workplace。TS/JS展示、复制、源码ZIP与正常包工程使用同一公开投影；没有源码alias或私改包产物。
